gap: The support-piece analogy and text are strong, but no picture locates B2M or contrasts the breadth of these two defects. Reuse the existing APM/HLA physical reference with a small allele-versus-shared-dependency comparison rather than a separate elaborate image.
accuracyGuardrails: A variant does not establish complete functional loss.
